quest.title: Dun Dun Dunnn! A Major Crisis!
quest.description: As you travel through Nod-Krai, you decide to take a stroll around Nasha Town...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Legion Morale x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4

chapter.title: Dun Dun Dunnn! A Major Crisis!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... There's so much space on this thing, but only one post. Let's see here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Ineffa needs help? Uh oh... What's this about a "major crisis" and "ruin"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should still head over and check on things, just in case!

talks.objective: Go take a walk around Nasha Town

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I will watch over things here. I leave Aino to you.

talks.objective: Go to the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ineffa! We saw your notice, and we're here to help! ...Hello? Anybody here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, she's gone... Does that mean she really ran into trouble she couldn't handle?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Ah, Paimon and {NICKNAME} are the first to arrive. Sincere apologies, I am unable to come down and greet you at the present moment. I will have to converse from up here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ineffa!? What the...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened? Did someone attack you?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Hmm... The logic of your conclusion is sound, but I would not use that word. After all, Aino is the one who did this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so Aino's the one who did this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, good idea. Does this giant magnet have a switch or something?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Request is not feasible. Aino has locked down the control system. Analyzing further options... Conclusion: The priority level of certain rules must be lowered.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Decision: I will temporarily override one of Aino's rules and inform you about the hidden control system. But first, I must be certain you will keep it a secret.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, um... Paimon didn't really understand any of that, hehe... But, don't worry! You can trust us for sure!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Sufficient grounds for override... Please proceed to the path to the side of the workshop and locate the robots scattered over there.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Once you have located all the specific robots, you can unlock the control system. This is the backdoor Aino established for herself, as she often forgets the password.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, so we just need to collect all the bots! We've got this!

choices.text: Let's get Ineffa down from there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Yeah, it does kinda seem like someone is having their fun.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Hmm... The logic of your conclusion is unsound. My calculations suggest trapping me here was a serious decision for Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Clink Clank Legion
dialogues.text: On standby. Waiting for command.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Clink Clank Legion, it's time to move out!

dialogues.speaker: Clink Clank Legion
dialogues.text: Move out!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Our objective is simple: Track down the thief and save our comrade!

dialogues.speaker: Clink Clank Legion
dialogues.text: Track down the thief! Save our comrade!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino, you have to stop this.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa? How did you get free? I thought the kuuvahki would be more than strong enough...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can't do this, Aino!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Aha, so you had help! Well, don't even think of trying to stop me! I don't care if I have to search all of Nod-Krai — I will find the person who did this!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And I have to go now, or "Krum-Clank 70% Sweet" will get dismantled and sold for parts!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Clink Clank Legion, move out!

dialogues.speaker: Clink Clank Legion
dialogues.text: Move out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do? It's not like we can resort to physical force!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino's sugar intake has already exceeded normal levels this month, but given the present situation... Are either of you carrying anything sweet with you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are we talking about dessert all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Desserts are the only thing that can get Aino to calm down, and I have already used up the allotment I had prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Okay, what's with the staring? Paimon's not one to leave leftovers, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fine... Paimon does have some she was saving for later.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino, why don't you calm down for a second and have some dessert?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmph, still treating me like a kid, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least it worked...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Listen... I know you guys think I'm making a big deal out of nothing... But, this wasn't just some scrap parts you can sell on the black market!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: This was a robot I was about to add to the workshop, just like Ineffa... And as the boss of this place, it's my job to look out for these bots!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Even though I'm the one who gets looked after most of the time... But, still! Not letting a bot get carted off right under my nose is the least I can do!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's a disgrace... I don't want to be that kind of boss...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino...

choices.text: None of us think you were making a big deal out of nothing...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: We can come up with a plan together. We'll help you get "Krum-Clank 70% Sweet" back safe and sound.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Thanks. And, um, about earlier... I'm sorry, Ineffa.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew... Looks like the military escapade's on hold for now.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Let's go back to the workshop.

choices.text: Often just makes the situation worse.
I probably would've done the same.

talks.objective: Help Ineffa out of the jam she is in

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Beep-beep.

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Zing-Zap Mechanical Claw backup control system now online. Enter a command.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shut down the Zing-Zap Mechanical Claw.

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Command confirmed. Shutting down Zing-Zap Mechanical Claw Number 1.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You okay, Ineffa?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Inspection in progress... All functions normal. I am unharmed. Aino adjusted the kuuvahki strength to make sure of that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what exactly happened?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Compiling relevant data... Simplification in progress... In short, Aino created a new robot companion not too long ago, but yesterday, someone stole it from the workshop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that explains it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, this is the "major crisis"?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I used that term because Aino intends to unleash the force of her entire fleet of combat robots against those suspected of the theft.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: If Aino manages to use her genius for destructive purposes, all of Nod-Krai will be facing a crisis the likes of which has never been seen before.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: When I attempted to stop her, she trapped me with that device. Fortunately, I was prepared for that possibility, and was able to post a request for help in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean that notice board in the middle of the square?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Correct. According to my calculations, posting that notice had a 94% chance of success, much higher than all other plans.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it was pretty hard to miss...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Fortunately, you arrived just in time. Aino and her robot fleet should still be at the workshop. Please follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You got it! Lead the way!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Job well done, everyone. Please enjoy some tea and dessert while we devise a plan of action.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so how is theft handled in Nod-Krai? Do we call the police or something?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, Nod-Krai is a largely autonomous region. There is no unified law enforcement organization.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Which means, "calling the police" is theoretically impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: See? That's why we have to take it into our own hands!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, turning all of Nod-Krai upside down seems a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What choice do I have? The thief somehow dodged my whole security system. I don't even know where to start searching.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Analyzing options... If their goal is Mora, the thief will likely head to Nasha Town to search for a buyer. I believe there will be useful clues there.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Nasha Town, huh... But, there are so many shady people there! Not the kind of people that like answering questions...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hm, it is not the best idea for you to interact with adults like that, Aino... I will handle the investigation instead.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Perhaps you can get started on the workshop's order backlog in the meantime. Keeping customers waiting too long could have a negative impact on our reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: About that... Krum-Clank's core was built using a special kind of power... one that incorporates kuuvahki.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I wanted to test it out, so I took orders that I knew would require Krum-Clank's help to complete.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But with Krum-Clank missing, there's no way I can get them done... Hmph, curse that rotten thief!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hmm... Analyzing other solutions... All foreseeable results are anticipated to have a negative effect on the workshop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Kuuvahki... Wait, {NICKNAME} can use that too!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What? How is that possible?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Calculations complete. Adequate solution identified.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I would like to enlist your services to help Aino clear the workshop backlog. You will, of course, be generously compensated for your labor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, no need for that! We're all friends here, right? We'd be more than happy to help! Besides, it might give us a chance to learn more about Nod-Krai!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Much appreciated! Then, in the meantime, I will take care of the investigation in Nasha Town.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #...Nope! I'm gonna do that, too! With {NICKNAME}'s help, I'm confident I can do both!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I need you here, Ineffa. Someone needs to watch over the workshop and make sure nothing else gets stolen. You're the only one I trust to do that.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Besides, rescuing our stolen comrade is a job for the boss of this place. And that happens to be me!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...Then I will defer to you, boss.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Alright, Clink Clank Legion! Move out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino sure is determined, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Well, she is the boss of the workshop, and a capable one at that. Please have faith in her abilities and... look out for her if she needs help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! Just leave it to us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see. Who around here looks like a thief? Huh... A lot of people, actually...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We haven't actually been in Nod-Krai that long, so we don't know much about this place. Where do we even start?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you think, Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, you must know this place like the back of your hand! Got any ideas?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmm... We could yell out, "which one of you is the rotten thief who stole from the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop?" Then, we see who starts to sweat, and we grab 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Honestly? Terrible idea.

choices.text: A lot of adults out there do bad things...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: No way! Sometimes I sneak a dessert when I'm not supposed to, and I always feel super guilty, even if Ineffa doesn't catch on.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Maybe we should ask Ineffa what to do... But, I really wanna do this on my own...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess you don't really interact with people outside the workshop, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, don't worry! Let's just start asking around. We're bound to find some clues that way!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: ...Okay.

choices.text: And don't even feel guilty about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Voynich Guild... If we wanna see if a transaction took place, it couldn't hurt to ask around here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Voynich Guild! Heavens above, if it isn't the owner of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop herself. What an honor this is!

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: And quite a rare one at that... We're always sending orders out to your workshop, but rarely do we have the pleasure of doing business in person!

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Are you looking to sell one of your pieces? I'm sure we can land on a price that'll leave you satisfied.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Sell? One of my bots? You wish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, um, one of Aino's bots was stolen, so we wanted to see if the Guild had any record of a sale or something.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: I see. This bot must mean a great deal to you, Miss Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Duh!

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: I wish the Voynich Guild could offer you some sort of consolation... But I'm afraid I have no recollection of such a sale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay. We'll get out of your hair then. C'mon, let's keep asking around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, is that a Fatui Agent over there? Maybe our thief got mixed up with them! Let's go see if he knows anything!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But... Ineffa says most Fatui Agents are bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay. I've got your back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello...

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: Stop right there! I don't do business out in the open, so we'll talk like this. Introduce yourselves first. What faction are you affiliated with?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Faction? I don't belong to a faction. I'm the boss of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop.

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: Ah, so someone we don't want to mess with... Is there a conflict between us that I don't know about? I've never trespassed on your property, as far as I can recall.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, um... We're not here to settle a score or anything. We just want to know if anyone's tried to use a stolen bot to pay off a debt?

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: Of course not. I don't accept stolen property. If the owner comes knocking, it becomes my problem, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: True... Guess we'll just have to keep looking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... If the thief's plan was to sell your bot, maybe we should start by asking the local blacksmiths? After all, blacksmiths need all kinds of raw materials.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, good point!

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: You're looking for a blacksmith? To be honest, I consider myself more a researcher motivated by personal interest... Wait, Aino? You're here in person? That's a first!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Something terrible has happened, so I had to come! One of my bots was stolen! Has anyone come by to sell it?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Wow, someone had the nerve to steal from your workshop? Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe you should describe what "Krum-Clank 70% Sweet" looks like, Aino. Might help jog her memory.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Oh, no need. I know Aino's style. I'd recognize it anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: But the only thing that's come my way recently is boring scrap metal. Nothing that looked even remotely like your work...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe the thief hasn't pawned it off yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, maybe... Well, thanks for the help. We'll keep looking.

talks.objective: Head to the shop Aino has designated

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa told me about it. "If you can pay, there's a way." That's what it's famous for.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: Welcome! Please feel free to peruse our Sumeru specialties. I'm more than happy to assist with any additional requests as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, isn't this Dori's shop? Okay, this actually isn't a bad idea... You never know what kind of stuff Dori's got stashed away.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: Can I help you with something?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: One of my bots was stolen yesterday, and I wanna know if the thief sold it to your shop!

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: Hmm, is it valuable? We only accept goods that we can use to turn a profit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's Dori's business acumen for ya...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Turn a profit... I don't like to think about my bots that way, but, well... Merchants usually find them pretty valuable.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: In that case, let me check...

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: Ah, apologies. We have no record of any transactions, over the past two days, involving mechanical constructs.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: *sigh* I thought we'd find something here, for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay, Aino! We'll think of something. Maybe we could ask this guy to check again, or...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oho, well if it isn't Aino and her two outlander friends. Asking around Nasha Town for intel, are we? You're lucky you didn't get swindled six ways from Sunday.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, dumpster-diver. It's you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Okay, now that was just uncalled for. I've got a name, pipsqueak — use it. Now, listen. Word on the street is, someone stole one of your constructs...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's not a construct. It's a companion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Your, uh, "intelligence mission" or whatever... Yeah, you weren't exactly being subtle. Word's spread throughout all of Nasha Town, I bet.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: But you're in luck, Aino, because the best bounty hunter in the land has decided to take up your cause.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Smart as a whip, she navigates the major factions with ease, always with her finger on the pulse of all the goings on in Nod-Krai. If you wanna get back what you lost, she's your best bet.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Uh... Who is?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Who!? Ugh, me, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Krum-Clank is doomed!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (What was with that reaction? Does she think I'm a liability or something?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey, with me on your side, there's still hope! But first, we gotta agree on terms. My services don't come cheap, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You're really gonna charge us? I don't charge you when you just swing by and help yourself to my desserts — well, technically Ineffa's desserts, seeing as she's the one who makes them...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Why is she bringing that up all of a sudden? I mean it's true, but still... There goes my chances of making some easy cash. Now, I just look ungrateful...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, if you're not gonna pay, then—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda, you really look out for the kid, don't you? Coming over to help like this... It means a lot! Aino really cares about this bot, y'know! Paimon knows you're not the type to abandon a friend in need!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (That's it, I'm done for. There's no backing out now.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Heh, you know me. C'mon, this way.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, we're here.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I don't see Krum-Clank anywhere! Did you lie to me again, dumpster-diver?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Have some patience, and hear the professional out. Now, Aino's style is super unique. When one of her creations shows up for sale, you can be sure that people will know who it belongs to.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You might look like an easy target, but everyone knows you've got me and my boss behind you. Point is, there's not a single person in Nod-Krai who'd steal one of your bots and go sell it on the regular black market.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Not an above-board one, anyway. But an illegal black market like this... That's another matter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but... aren't all black markets illegal?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Maybe, but that doesn't mean there aren't any rules. My boss sets 'em, and there are people who follow them and people who don't. And that market over there? Yeah, that's where the rule-breakers go to make deals.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And based on the intel I have, this market deals almost exclusively in mechanical constructs. Ring any bells?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're a genius, Jahoda! But, um... There's no one here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The key to a market like this is operating in secret. There's no chance it runs every day. I asked around my circle, and it seems like our next chance to check it out is in two days' time.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: We have to wait two days?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Eh, that's nothin'. Even if your bot's on its last legs, two days ain't gonna change much.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Now, you listen up! Krum-Clank belongs to my workshop! I'm the boss, and no bot of mine is getting hurt on my watch!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Sheesh, this kid's got a temper. Maybe I should apologize? No, wait. I'm not about to be intimidated by some little squirt...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, where did that come from?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's alright. I mean, it's understandable...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The kid built up the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop all on her own, and she has more interactions with robots than people most days.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm sure, for her, these bots are everything.

choices.text: Sitting around for two days doing nothing...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Yeah, I know that. But, that's the only lead I can give you right now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Aino, Jahoda's just trying to help. You know that, right? At least think about it.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: ...Fine. If we have to wait, then... we'll wait. Get it together, Aino — you're the boss. You need to keep your cool.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Well, that took some convincing... Alright, then. Let's meet here in two days.

choices.text: Is going to be really hard for her.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Does your stolen bot use kuuvahki by any chance? Bots like that have been super popular on the market lately...

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Ah, here's a thought. If you could provide me with a detailed description of your lost item, I could keep an eye out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to collect debts when there are so many people around here that I can't afford to cross...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, we've been in Nod-Krai for a while now, but we still don't know much about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now we've got some free time, why don't we go explore Nasha Town for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this place is buzzing with activity... Oh, hey! There's a notice board over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, what a crazy hiding spot... Aino wasn't taking any chances, was she...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it seems like we've exhausted all our options here. Where else should we look?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Lemme think... Right! There's one more place we haven't searched — that shop!
